description: This file is a header (.h) file defining functions, types, and constants for managing 'extension modules' in a wireless layer software. It includes function declarations for registering, unregistering, and managing extension modules and their associated data, along with related data structures and delete handler type definitions.

methods.name: wld_extMod_register
methods.description: Registers a new extension module with vendor and module names, returning an index if successful.

methods.name: wld_extMod_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an extension module by its index, after cleanup.

methods.name: wld_extMod_isValidId
methods.description: Checks whether a given extension module ID is currently valid/registered.

methods.name: wld_extMod_initDataList
methods.description: Initializes a data list for extension modules.

methods.name: wld_extMod_registerData
methods.description: Registers extension module data with associated delete handler in a data list.

methods.name: wld_extMod_getData
methods.description: Retrieves registered extension module data by ID.

methods.name: wld_extMod_unregisterData
methods.description: Unregisters extension module data for a given ID.

methods.name: wld_extMod_cleanupDataList
methods.description: Cleans up all extension module data from a list, calling delete handlers.
